name: Cheddar Beach 0 - Party on Mango St.
source:
Take a trip to Cheddar Beach in this visual novel. Join Hamston & The Homies as they search for a crackin’ house party on a Friday night - in a world before everybody & their mom had cellphones. Let’s make some friends & Chase That Cheese, Y’all!!!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755510/Cheddar_Beach_0__Party_on_Mango_St/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中踏上前往切达海滩的旅途吧！在那个还没到人人连带自家老妈都人手一部手机的年代，跟随哈姆斯顿与死党们在周五夜晚四处寻找一场嗨翻天的家庭派对。广交好友，大伙儿一起来“追逐奶酪”吧！！！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755510/Cheddar_Beach_0__Party_on_Mango_St/]Steam[/url]]
